## Check individual identities and sex assignments

Reviewer 2 asked how repeated individuals and pairs were identified. Before
calculating wing differences, I checked the recorded identities against the
available molecular sexing results and applied the confirmed field corrections.
When the sex of a parent changed, its measurements and bander moved with its ID.

```{r identities}
vp$.row <- seq_len(nrow(vp))
vpop$.row <- seq_len(nrow(vpop))
vp$Nestbox <- trimws(vp$Nestbox)
vpop$Nestbox <- trimws(vpop$Nestbox)
for (nm in c("Male.ID", "Female.ID")) vp[[nm]] <- as.character(vp[[nm]])
vpop$ID <- as.character(vpop$ID)
lab <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel(sex_file, sheet = "PCR and GE"))
lab$.source_row <- seq_len(nrow(lab)) + 1L
norm_sex <- function(x) ifelse(tolower(trimws(x)) %in% c("male", "m"), "M", ifelse(tolower(trimws(x)) %in%
  c("female", "f"), "F", NA_character_))
sex_key <- function(x) toupper(gsub("[[:space:]-]", "", as.character(x)))
lab$ID <- sex_key(lab$USGS)
lab$Sex <- norm_sex(lab[["Lab sex"]])
lab <- lab[!is.na(lab$Sex) & !is.na(lab$ID), c("ID", "Sex", ".source_row")]
stopifnot(all((lab %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(Sex), .groups = "drop"))$n == 1))
lab <- lab[!duplicated(lab$ID), ]
sex_map <- setNames(lab$Sex, lab$ID)
log_rows <- list()
add_log <- function(dataset, row, field, old, new, basis) {
  log_rows[[length(log_rows) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(dataset, source_row = row, field, old = as.character(old),
    new = as.character(new), basis)
}

add_log("user_sex_override", NA_integer_, "Sex:297010848", sex_map["297010848"], "F", "Sara assigned 297010848 female on 2026-10-26; overrides workbook Male entry")
sex_map["297010848"] <- "F"

for (spec in list(list(nest = "SGR-222", sex = "Male", old = "291053989", new = "291053990", row = 52),
  list(nest = "SGR-137", sex = "Female", old = "291053960", new = "291053973", row = 48))) {
  ii <- which(vp$Year == 2021 & vp$Nestbox == spec$nest)
  stopifnot(length(ii) == 1, vp[[paste0(spec$sex, ".ID")]][ii] == spec$old)
  add_log("paired", vp$.row[ii], paste0(spec$sex, ".ID"), spec$old, spec$new, paste("2021 adult banding sheet row",
    spec$row))
  vp[[paste0(spec$sex, ".ID")]][ii] <- spec$new
  jj <- which(vpop$Year == 2021 & vpop$Nestbox == spec$nest & vpop$Sex == if (spec$sex == "Male")
    "M" else "F")
  stopifnot(length(jj) <= 1)
  if (length(jj) == 1) {
    stopifnot(vpop$ID[jj] == spec$old)
    add_log("population", vpop$.row[jj], "ID", spec$old, spec$new, paste("2021 adult banding sheet row",
      spec$row))
    vpop$ID[jj] <- spec$new
  }
}

for (nm in c("Male.ID", "Female.ID")) {
  new_id <- sex_key(vp[[nm]])
  for (j in which(vp[[nm]] != new_id)) add_log("paired", vp$.row[j], nm, vp[[nm]][j], new_id[j], "Case/separator normalization of identity key")
  vp[[nm]] <- new_id
}
new_id <- sex_key(vpop$ID)

  vp$Nestbox[conflict], vp$Male.ID[conflict], vp$Female.ID[conflict], sep = "/"), collapse = "; "),
  ". Resolve the laboratory result or parent ID before rebuilding tables."))


paired_suffixes <- c("ID", "Recorded.Band.ID", "Wing.Chord", "Tarsus", "Bill", "Weight", "BillHead")
paired_extra <- list(c("MaleBander", "FemaleBander"))
for (j in seq_len(nrow(vp))) {
  ms <- unname(sex_map[sex_key(vp$Male.ID[j])])
  fs <- unname(sex_map[sex_key(vp$Female.ID[j])])
  swap <- (!is.na(ms) && ms == "F") || (!is.na(fs) && fs == "M")
  if (swap) {
    stopifnot(!(identical(ms, "F") && identical(fs, "F")), !(identical(ms, "M") && identical(fs,
      "M")))
    oldm <- vp$Male.ID[j]
    oldf <- vp$Female.ID[j]
    for (suf in paired_suffixes) {
      mn <- paste0("Male.", suf)
      fn <- paste0("Female.", suf)
      tmp <- vp[[mn]][j]
      vp[[mn]][j] <- vp[[fn]][j]
      vp[[fn]][j] <- tmp
    }
    for (pair in paired_extra) if (all(pair %in% names(vp))) {
      tmp <- vp[[pair[1]]][j]
      vp[[pair[1]]][j] <- vp[[pair[2]]][j]
      vp[[pair[2]]][j] <- tmp
    }
    for (id in c(oldm, oldf)) {
      role <- if (id == vp$Male.ID[j])
        "M" else "F"
      if (is.na(sex_map[sex_key(id)])) {
        sex_map[sex_key(id)] <- role
        add_log("identity", vp$.row[j], paste0("Sex:", id), "unconfirmed", role, "Opposite role inferred within established breeding pair after partner's molecular sex correction")
      }
    }
    add_log("paired", vp$.row[j], "Male/Female individual records", paste(oldm, oldf, sep = "/"),
      paste(vp$Male.ID[j], vp$Female.ID[j], sep = "/"), "PCR and GE laboratory sex; swapped all ID-linked measurements and bander, not just ID labels")
  }
}
for (j in seq_len(nrow(vpop))) {
  verified <- unname(sex_map[sex_key(vpop$ID[j])])
  if (!is.na(verified) && verified != vpop$Sex[j]) {
    add_log("population", vpop$.row[j], "Sex", vpop$Sex[j], verified, if (vpop$ID[j] == "297010848")
      "Sara's female assignment, 2026-10-26" else if (vpop$ID[j] %in% lab$ID)
      "PCR and GE laboratory sex" else "Partner role inferred from established breeding pair")
    vpop$Sex[j] <- verified
  }
}

vp$Pair.ID <- paste(vp$Male.ID, vp$Female.ID, sep = "-")
vp$Wing_Difference <- vp$Male.Wing.Chord - vp$Female.Wing.Chord
vp$Avg.Wing <- (vp$Male.Wing.Chord + vp$Female.Wing.Chord)/2
for (pre in c("male", "female")) {

    "Male" else "Female"

  vp[[paste0(pre, ".logmass")]] <- log(vp[[paste0(sex, ".Weight")]])
}
for (suf in c("Tarsus", "Bill", "Weight", "BillHead")) {
  nm <- paste0(suf, "_Difference")
  if (all(c(paste0("Male.", suf), paste0("Female.", suf), nm) %in% names(vp)))
    vp[[nm]] <- vp[[paste0("Male.", suf)]] - vp[[paste0("Female.", suf)]]
}
vpop$logwing <- log(vpop$Wing.Chord)
vpop$logmass <- log(vpop$Mass)

for (j in seq_len(nrow(vp))) for (sex in c("Male", "Female")) {
  id <- vp[[paste0(sex, ".ID")]][j]
  matched <- which(vpop$ID == id & vpop$Year == vp$Year[j])
  if (length(matched) == 0L) {
    nr <- vpop[1, , drop = FALSE]
    nr[1, ] <- NA
    for (nm in c("Location", "Nestbox", "Species", "Year", "Elevation")) nr[[nm]] <- vp[[nm]][j]
    nr$ID <- id
    nr$Recorded.Band.ID <- vp[[paste0(sex, ".Recorded.Band.ID")]][j]
    nr$Sex <- if (sex == "Male")
      "M" else "F"
    nr$Wing.Chord <- vp[[paste0(sex, ".Wing.Chord")]][j]
    nr$Mass <- vp[[paste0(sex, ".Weight")]][j]
    nr$Bander <- vp[[paste0(sex, "Bander")]][j]
    nr$.row <- max(vpop$.row) + 1L
    nr$logwing <- log(nr$Wing.Chord)
    nr$logmass <- log(nr$Mass)
    vpop <- bind_rows(vpop, nr)
    add_log("population", nr$.row, "Added paired capture", NA, paste(id, vp$Year[j], sep = "/"),
      "Observed wing record absent from SMI-ready population CSV; retain missing mass, restore for wing-only analyses")
  }
}
```

## Reviewer 2: how was SMI calculated?

The SMI exponent and reference wing length are estimated separately for each
species and sex. Each parent then gets an SMI using its measurements from that
breeding attempt. The shared wing component is checked later in this Rmd.

```{r SMI_calculation}
# Estimate the SMA exponent and mean wing length separately for each species and sex. Use the first complete capture by year, with source order breaking ties.
calibration <- vpop %>%
  filter(is.finite(Wing.Chord), Wing.Chord > 0, is.finite(Mass), Mass > 0) %>%
  arrange(Year, .row) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)
smi_parameters <- calibration %>%
  group_by(Species, Sex) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), reference_wing = mean(Wing.Chord), cor_log = cor(log(Mass), log(Wing.Chord)),
    exponent = sign(cor(log(Mass), log(Wing.Chord))) * sd(log(Mass))/sd(log(Wing.Chord)), .groups = "drop")
stopifnot(nrow(smi_parameters) == 4, all(is.finite(smi_parameters$exponent)))
for (j in seq_len(nrow(vp))) for (sex in c("Male", "Female")) {
  pp <- smi_parameters[smi_parameters$Species == vp$Species[j] & smi_parameters$Sex == if (sex == "Male")
    "M" else "F", ]
  vp[[paste0(sex, "_SMI")]][j] <- vp[[paste0(sex, ".Weight")]][j] * (pp$reference_wing/vp[[paste0(sex,
    ".Wing.Chord")]][j])^pp$exponent
}
for (j in seq_len(nrow(vpop))) {
  pp <- smi_parameters[smi_parameters$Species == vpop$Species[j] & smi_parameters$Sex == vpop$Sex[j],
    ]
  vpop$SMI[j] <- vpop$Mass[j] * (pp$reference_wing/vpop$Wing.Chord[j])^pp$exponent
}
thresholds <- c(BCCH = 4, MOCH = 3)
stopifnot(median(vp$Wing_Difference[vp$Species == "BCCH" & vp$Wing_Difference > 0]) == 4, median(vp$Wing_Difference[vp$Species ==
  "MOCH" & vp$Wing_Difference > 0]) == 3)
# MOCH: Slightly is >0 to 3 mm; BCCH: Slightly is >0 and <4 mm.
vp$Wing_Difference_Category <- with(vp, ifelse(Wing_Difference < 0, "Female", ifelse(Wing_Difference ==
  0, "Same", ifelse((Species == "MOCH" & Wing_Difference <= thresholds["MOCH"]) | (Species == "BCCH" &
  Wing_Difference < thresholds["BCCH"]), "Slightly", "Much"))))
vp$Elevation_km <- (vp$Elevation - 2000)/1000
vp$.canonical_pair <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(vp)), function(i) paste(sort(c(vp$Male.ID[i], vp$Female.ID[i])),
  collapse = "|"), character(1))
stopifnot(!any(vp$Male.ID == vp$Female.ID), length(intersect(vp$Male.ID, vp$Female.ID)) == 0, !anyDuplicated(vp[c("Year",
  "Pair.ID")]), all((vp %>%
  count(Year, Male.ID))$n == 1), all((vp %>%
  count(Year, Female.ID))$n == 1))
stopifnot(all(is.na(sex_map[sex_key(vp$Male.ID)]) | sex_map[sex_key(vp$Male.ID)] == "M"), all(is.na(sex_map[sex_key(vp$Female.ID)]) |
  sex_map[sex_key(vp$Female.ID)] == "F"))
inferred_ids <- unique(sub("^Sex:", "", bind_rows(log_rows)$field[bind_rows(log_rows)$dataset == "identity"]))
role_audit <- bind_rows(lapply(c("Male", "Female"), function(sx) {
  ids <- unique(vp[[paste0(sx, ".ID")]])
  data.frame(ID = ids, assigned_sex = if (sx == "Male")
    "M" else "F", workbook_lab_sex = ifelse(grepl("_", ids), ifelse(ids == "291054116_2022_BLD365", "F",
    NA_character_), lab$Sex[match(ids, lab$ID)]), assignment_source = ifelse(ids == "297010848",
    "Sara correction 2026-10-26", ifelse(ids %in% inferred_ids, "Inferred opposite role within established pair",
      ifelse((!grepl("_", ids) & ids %in% lab$ID) | ids == "291054116_2022_BLD365", "PCR and GE laboratory result",
        "Existing field assignment; no matching lab result"))))
}))
write.csv(role_audit, file.path(output_dir, "sex_assignment_audit.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(vp, file.path(output_dir, "paired_corrected.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(vpop, file.path(output_dir, "population_corrected.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(log_rows), file.path(output_dir, "correction_provenance.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(lab, file.path(output_dir, "molecular_sex_lookup.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(smi_parameters, file.path(output_dir, "SMI_parameters.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data.frame(Species = names(thresholds), threshold = thresholds), file.path(output_dir, "category_thresholds.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE)
```

## Reviewer 2: report the sampling structure

Count breeding attempts, unique parents, and unique pairs separately.  
```{r sampling}
annual <- BS %>%
  count(Year, Species, name = "attempts") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = attempts, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = BCCH + MOCH)
lineage <- BS %>%
  group_by(Location, Species, Year) %>%
  summarise(attempts = n(), pairs = n_distinct(Pair.ID), males = n_distinct(Male.ID), females = n_distinct(Female.ID),
    elevation_mean = mean(Elevation), elevation_min = min(Elevation), elevation_max = max(Elevation),
    .groups = "drop")
sample_rows <- list()
for (y in responses) {
  for (sp in c("BCCH", "MOCH")) {
    ss <- BS[BS$Species == sp & complete.cases(BS[c(y, "Wing_Difference", "Elevation_km", "Year")]),
      ]
    sample_rows[[paste(y, sp)]] <- data.frame(response = y, Species = sp, n = nrow(ss), unique_males = n_distinct(ss$Male.ID),
      unique_females = n_distinct(ss$Female.ID), unique_ordered_pairs = n_distinct(ss$Pair.ID),
      unique_unordered_pairs = n_distinct(ss$.canonical_pair), years = paste(sort(unique(ss$Year)),
        collapse = ", "))
  }
}
samples <- bind_rows(sample_rows)
paired_descriptives <- BS %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(attempts = n(), pairs = n_distinct(Pair.ID), males = n_distinct(Male.ID), females = n_distinct(Female.ID),
    wingdiff_min = min(Wing_Difference), wingdiff_max = max(Wing_Difference), mean_wing = mean(Avg.Wing),
    .groups = "drop")
repeated_pairs <- BS %>%
  count(Species, .canonical_pair, name = "n_attempts") %>%
  filter(n_attempts > 1)
repeated_individuals <- bind_rows(lapply(c("Male", "Female"), function(sex) {
  BS %>%
    group_by(Species, ID = .data[[paste0(sex, ".ID")]]) %>%
    summarise(n_attempts = n(), years = paste(sort(unique(Year)), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_attempts > 1) %>%
    mutate(Sex = sex)
}))
write.csv(annual, file.path(output_dir, "annual_sampled_attempts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(lineage, file.path(output_dir, "site_year_sample_lineage.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Sexual size dimorphism and the relationship between mate wing lengths

The reviewers asked for confidence intervals and clearer descriptions of the
size measurements. These are the population, within-pair, and mate wing models
reported in Table S2. Each adult is represented once in the population model.

```{r dimorphism_and_mate_wings}
mods <- list(population_dimorphism = lmerTest::lmer(Wing.Chord ~ Sex * Species + (1 | Bander), BSpopI),
  pair_dimorphism = lmerTest::lmer(Wing_Difference ~ Species + (1 | Year), BS), MOCH_pairing = lmerTest::lmer(Male.Wing.Chord ~
    Female.Wing.Chord + (1 | Year), BS[BS$Species == "MOCH", ]), BCCH_pairing = lmerTest::lmer(Male.Wing.Chord ~
    Female.Wing.Chord + (1 | Year), BS[BS$Species == "BCCH", ]))
cf <- list()
rv <- list()
for (nm in names(mods)) {
  f <- mods[[nm]]
  ct <- coef(summary(f))
  cr <- qt(0.975, ct[, "df"])
  cf[[nm]] <- data.frame(model = nm, n = nobs(f), term = rownames(ct), estimate = ct[, 1], SE = ct[,
    2], df = ct[, 3], statistic = ct[, 4], p = ct[, 5], CI_low = ct[, 1] - cr * ct[, 2], CI_high = ct[,
    1] + cr * ct[, 2], row.names = NULL)
  rv[[nm]] <- data.frame(model = nm, as.data.frame(lme4::VarCorr(f)), singular = lme4::isSingular(f))
}
write.csv(bind_rows(cf), file.path(output_dir, "dimorphism_pairing_full_models.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(rv), file.path(output_dir, "dimorphism_pairing_variances.csv"), row.names = FALSE)


summary(mods$population_dimorphism)
summary(mods$pair_dimorphism)
summary(mods$MOCH_pairing)
summary(mods$BCCH_pairing)

# Check the random terms removed from the preliminary SSD models.
preliminary <- list(population_year = lmerTest::lmer(Wing.Chord ~ Sex * Species + (1 | Bander) + (1 |
  Year), BSpopI), pair_banders = lmerTest::lmer(Wing_Difference ~ Species + (1 | Year) + (1 | MaleBander) +
  (1 | FemaleBander), BS))
preliminary_variances <- bind_rows(lapply(names(preliminary), function(nm) {
  data.frame(model = nm, as.data.frame(VarCorr(preliminary[[nm]])), singular = isSingular(preliminary[[nm]]))
}))
write.csv(preliminary_variances, file.path(output_dir, "preliminary_SSD_variances.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Sex contrasts for each species, using Satterthwaite degrees of freedom.
contrasts <- list()
for (sp in c("BCCH", "MOCH")) {
  L <- if (sp == "BCCH")
    c(0, 1, 0, 0) else c(0, 1, 0, 1)
  contrasts[[paste(sp, "population")]] <- data.frame(Species = sp, contrast = "population_sex_difference",
    contest1D(mods$population_dimorphism, L, confint = TRUE), check.names = FALSE)
  L <- if (sp == "BCCH")
    c(1, 0) else c(1, 1)
  contrasts[[paste(sp, "pair")]] <- data.frame(Species = sp, contrast = "within_pair_difference", contest1D(mods$pair_dimorphism,
    L, confint = TRUE), check.names = FALSE)
}
sex_contrasts <- bind_rows(contrasts)
population_descriptives <- BSpopI %>%
  group_by(Species, Sex) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean_wing = mean(Wing.Chord), sd_wing = sd(Wing.Chord), .groups = "drop")
pearson <- bind_rows(lapply(c("BCCH", "MOCH"), function(sp) {
  ss <- BS[BS$Species == sp, ]
  cc <- cor.test(ss$Female.Wing.Chord, ss$Male.Wing.Chord)
  data.frame(Species = sp, n = nrow(ss), r = unname(cc$estimate), CI_low = cc$conf.int[1], CI_high = cc$conf.int[2],
    p = cc$p.value)
}))
write.csv(sex_contrasts, file.path(output_dir, "verified_descriptive_contrasts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(population_descriptives, file.path(output_dir, "population_wing_descriptives.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(pearson, file.path(output_dir, "pearson_correlations.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Reviewer 1: is wing length related to elevation?

Fit the elevation models separately for each species and sex. Elevation is in
1,000 m units. Year is a random intercept; its variance is reported even when it
is estimated at zero.

```{r wing_and_elevation}
elevation_models <- list()
elevation_results <- list()
for (sp in c("BCCH", "MOCH")) {
  for (sex in c("F", "M")) {
    ss <- BSpopI[BSpopI$Species == sp & BSpopI$Sex == sex & complete.cases(BSpopI[c("Wing.Chord",
      "Elevation", "Year")]), ]
    ss$Elevation_km <- (ss$Elevation - 2000)/1000
    fit <- lmerTest::lmer(Wing.Chord ~ Elevation_km + (1 | Year), ss)
    cc <- coef(summary(fit))["Elevation_km", ]
    critical <- qt(0.975, cc["df"])
    elevation_models[[paste(sp, sex)]] <- fit
    elevation_results[[paste(sp, sex)]] <- data.frame(Species = sp, Sex = sex, n = nobs(fit), estimate = cc[1],
      SE = cc[2], df = cc[3], statistic = cc[4], p = cc[5], CI_low = cc[1] - critical * cc[2],
      CI_high = cc[1] + critical * cc[2], year_variance = as.data.frame(VarCorr(fit))$vcov[1],
      singular = isSingular(fit))
  }
}
elevation_results <- bind_rows(elevation_results)
write.csv(elevation_results, file.path(output_dir, "elevation_wing_sensitivity.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
elevation_results
```


## Reviewer 2: test the differences between species directly

The combined models include species, male-minus-female wing length, and their
interaction. I also fit separate models for each species. All reproductive
models include elevation and categorical year. Count responses use COM-Poisson
models; the combined clutch model allows dispersion to differ between species.
The seven interaction tests are adjusted together, and the seven slopes within
each species are adjusted separately.

```{r species_comparisons}
# The same formulas are used again for the repeated-parent checks.
fit_reproductive <- function(response, data, scope) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste(response, if (scope == "combined")
    "~ Wing_Difference * Species + Elevation_km + factor(Year)" else "~ Wing_Difference + Elevation_km + factor(Year)"))
  if (response %in% count_responses) {
    fit <- glmmTMB(formula, data = data, family = compois(link = "log"), dispformula = if (response ==
      "Egg_Number" && scope == "combined")
      ~Species else ~1)
    stopifnot(fit$fit$convergence == 0, fit$sdr$pdHess)
  } else {
    fit <- lm(formula, data = data)
  }
  fit
}

# Get coefficients and intervals without fitting the model again.
coefficient_table <- function(fit) {
  count <- inherits(fit, "glmmTMB")
  cc <- if (count)
    coef(summary(fit))$cond else coef(summary(fit))
  critical <- if (count)
    qnorm(0.975) else qt(0.975, df.residual(fit))
  data.frame(term = rownames(cc), estimate = cc[, 1], SE = cc[, 2], CI_low = cc[, 1] - critical * cc[,
    2], CI_high = cc[, 1] + critical * cc[, 2], statistic = cc[, 3], p = cc[, 4], row.names = NULL)
}
focal_table <- function(fit, response, scope, scheme) {
  cc <- coefficient_table(fit)
  term <- if (scope == "combined")
    "Wing_Difference:SpeciesMOCH" else "Wing_Difference"
  data.frame(response, scheme, scope, n = nobs(fit), cc[cc$term == term, ], row.names = NULL)
}

fits <- list()
primary_rows <- list()
for (y in responses) {
  eligible <- BS[complete.cases(BS[c(y, "Wing_Difference", "Elevation_km", "Year", "Species")]), ]
  for (scope in c("combined", "BCCH", "MOCH")) {
    ss <- if (scope == "combined")
      eligible else eligible[eligible$Species == scope, ]
    key <- paste(y, "all_attempts", scope, sep = "|")
    fits[[key]] <- fit_reproductive(y, ss, scope)
    primary_rows[[key]] <- focal_table(fits[[key]], y, scope, "all_attempts")
    print(summary(fits[[key]]))
  }
}
primary_effects <- bind_rows(primary_rows) %>%
  group_by(scope) %>%
  mutate(BH_p = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

full_rows <- list()
metadata_rows <- list()
for (i in seq_along(responses)) {
  y <- responses[i]
  for (scope in c("combined", "BCCH", "MOCH")) {
    fit <- fits[[paste(y, "all_attempts", scope, sep = "|")]]
    cc <- coefficient_table(fit)
    focal <- if (scope == "combined")
      "Wing_Difference:SpeciesMOCH" else "Wing_Difference"
    bh <- primary_effects$BH_p[primary_effects$response == y & primary_effects$scope == scope]
    cc$BH_p <- ifelse(cc$term == focal, bh, NA_real_)
    full_rows[[paste(y, scope)]] <- data.frame(response = y, label = response_labels[i], scope, cc)
    metadata_rows[[paste(y, scope)]] <- data.frame(response = y, scope, n = nobs(fit), family = if (y %in%
      count_responses)
      "COM-Poisson" else "Gaussian", link = if (y %in% count_responses)
      "log" else "identity", sigma = sigma(fit))
  }
}
full_primary <- bind_rows(full_rows)
table_1 <- primary_effects %>%
  filter(scope == "combined")
write.csv(primary_effects, file.path(output_dir, "primary_effects.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(full_primary, file.path(output_dir, "full_primary_models.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(metadata_rows), file.path(output_dir, "model_metadata.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(table_1, file.path(output_dir, "Table_1.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
table_files <- c("Table_S3_first_egg.csv", "Table_S4_clutch_size.csv", "Table_S5_brood_size.csv", "Table_S6_nestling_mass.csv",
  "Table_S7_female_SMI.csv", "Table_S8_male_SMI.csv", "Table_S9_provisioning.csv")
for (i in seq_along(responses)) {
  write.csv(full_primary[full_primary$response == responses[i], ], file.path(output_dir, table_files[i]),
    row.names = FALSE)
}
table_1
```


## Reviewers 1 and 2: repeated parents and pairs

Keep the earliest eligible attempt per pair, male, or female, and also make a
chronological subset with no shared parents. 

```{r repeated_parents}
select_attempts <- function(data, subset) {
  data <- data[order(data$Year, data$.row), ]
  if (subset == "first_pair")
    data <- data[!duplicated(data$.canonical_pair), ]
  if (subset == "first_male")
    data <- data[!duplicated(data$Male.ID), ]
  if (subset == "first_female")
    data <- data[!duplicated(data$Female.ID), ]
  if (subset == "exclude_inferred_roles") {
    data <- data[!data$Male.ID %in% inferred_ids & !data$Female.ID %in% inferred_ids, ]
  }
  if (subset == "no_shared_parent") {
    keep <- logical(nrow(data))
    used <- character()
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(data))) {
      ids <- c(data$Male.ID[i], data$Female.ID[i])
      if (!any(ids %in% used)) {
        keep[i] <- TRUE
        used <- c(used, ids)
      }
    }
    data <- data[keep, ]
    stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(c(data$Male.ID, data$Female.ID)))
  }
  data
}

subsets <- c("first_pair", "first_male", "first_female", "no_shared_parent", "exclude_inferred_roles")
identity_rows <- list()
retained_rows <- list()
for (y in responses) {
  eligible <- BS[complete.cases(BS[c(y, "Wing_Difference", "Elevation_km", "Year", "Species")]), ]
  for (subset in subsets) {
    selected <- select_attempts(eligible, subset)
    retained_rows[[paste(y, subset)]] <- data.frame(response = y, subset, selected[c(".row", "Year",
      "Species", "Nestbox", "Male.ID", "Female.ID", "Pair.ID")])
    for (scope in c("combined", "BCCH", "MOCH")) {
      ss <- if (scope == "combined")
        selected else selected[selected$Species == scope, ]
      key <- paste(y, subset, scope, sep = "|")
      fits[[key]] <- fit_reproductive(y, ss, scope)
      identity_rows[[key]] <- focal_table(fits[[key]], y, scope, subset)
    }
  }
}
identity_effects <- bind_rows(primary_effects %>%
  select(-BH_p), bind_rows(identity_rows)) %>%
  group_by(scheme, scope) %>%
  mutate(BH_p = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()
write.csv(identity_effects, file.path(output_dir, "identity_sensitivity.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(retained_rows), file.path(output_dir, "retained_attempts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(fits, file.path(output_dir, "reproductive_models.rds"))
identity_effects %>%
  filter(scope == "combined", response %in% c("Nestling_Number", "Avg_Nestling_Weight"))
```

## Reviewer 2: check year as a random intercept

Compare the combined models with year treated as a random intercept. The fixed
year models remain the primary analysis. Report boundary year variances rather
than removing them from individual response models.

```{r random_year}
random_year_models <- list()
year_rows <- list()
for (y in responses) {
  ss <- BS[complete.cases(BS[c(y, "Wing_Difference", "Elevation_km", "Year")]), ]
  formula <- as.formula(paste(y, "~ Wing_Difference * Species + Elevation_km + (1|Year)"))
  count <- y %in% count_responses
  fit <- if (count)
    glmmTMB(formula, ss, family = compois(link = "log"), dispformula = if (y == "Egg_Number")
      ~Species else ~1) else lmerTest::lmer(formula, ss)
  if (count)
    stopifnot(fit$fit$convergence == 0, fit$sdr$pdHess)
  cc <- if (count)
    coef(summary(fit))$cond else coef(summary(fit))
  vv <- cc["Wing_Difference:SpeciesMOCH", ]
  critical <- if (count)
    qnorm(0.975) else qt(0.975, vv["df"])
  variance <- if (count)
    as.numeric(glmmTMB::VarCorr(fit)$cond$Year[1]) else as.data.frame(VarCorr(fit))$vcov[1]
  random_year_models[[y]] <- fit
  year_rows[[y]] <- data.frame(response = y, n = nobs(fit), estimate = vv[1], SE = vv[2], CI_low = vv[1] -
    critical * vv[2], CI_high = vv[1] + critical * vv[2], p = tail(vv, 1), year_variance = variance,
    boundary = variance < 1e-06)
}
year_results <- bind_rows(year_rows) %>%
  mutate(BH_p = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))
write.csv(year_results, file.path(output_dir, "year_random_sensitivity.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(random_year_models, file.path(output_dir, "year_random_models.rds"))
year_results
```


## Reviewer 2: sensitivity to the band-number inconsistencies

The four capture records with the two copied band numbers are treated as
independent records in the primary data. As a conservative check, exclude these
records and recalculate the SMI parameters before fitting the same models.

```{r band_number_sensitivity}
d <- BS
p <- BSpop
b <- output_dir
ids <- c("294018398", "291054116")
conf <- p[p$Recorded.Band.ID %in% ids, c("ID", "Recorded.Band.ID", "Species", "Sex", "Year", "Nestbox",
  "Wing.Chord", "Mass")]
conf$identity_basis <- "Sara 2026-10-27: probable copied band IDs; treat captures independently; true replacement band numbers unknown"
write.csv(conf, file.path(b, "independent_record_identity_assumptions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
q <- p[!p$Recorded.Band.ID %in% ids, ]
cal <- q %>%
  filter(is.finite(Mass), Mass > 0, is.finite(Wing.Chord), Wing.Chord > 0) %>%
  arrange(Year, .row) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)
parms <- cal %>%
  group_by(Species, Sex) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), L0 = mean(Wing.Chord), exponent = sign(cor(log(Mass), log(Wing.Chord))) * sd(log(Mass))/sd(log(Wing.Chord)),
    .groups = "drop")
dd <- d[!d$Male.Recorded.Band.ID %in% ids & !d$Female.Recorded.Band.ID %in% ids, ]
for (i in seq_len(nrow(dd))) for (sex in c("Male", "Female")) {
  z <- parms[parms$Species == dd$Species[i] & parms$Sex == if (sex == "Male")
    "M" else "F", ]
  dd[[paste0(sex, "_SMI")]][i] <- dd[[paste0(sex, ".Weight")]][i] * (z$L0/dd[[paste0(sex, ".Wing.Chord")]][i])^z$exponent
}
ys <- c("First.Egg", "Egg_Number", "Nestling_Number", "Avg_Nestling_Weight", "Female_SMI", "Male_SMI",
  "Provisioning")
ef <- list()
fs <- list()
for (y in ys) for (sc in c("combined", "BCCH", "MOCH")) {
  ss <- dd[complete.cases(dd[c(y, "Wing_Difference", "Species", "Year", "Elevation_km")]), ]
  if (sc != "combined")
    ss <- ss[ss$Species == sc, ]
  ss$Species <- factor(ss$Species, levels = c("BCCH", "MOCH"))
  fm <- as.formula(paste(y, if (sc == "combined")
    "~ Wing_Difference*Species+Elevation_km+factor(Year)" else "~ Wing_Difference+Elevation_km+factor(Year)"))
  count <- y %in% c("Egg_Number", "Nestling_Number")
  f <- if (count)
    glmmTMB::glmmTMB(fm, ss, family = glmmTMB::compois, dispformula = if (y == "Egg_Number" && sc ==
      "combined")
      ~Species else ~1) else lm(fm, ss)
  if (count)
    stopifnot(f$fit$convergence == 0, f$sdr$pdHess)
  ct <- if (count)
    coef(summary(f))$cond else coef(summary(f))
  term <- if (sc == "combined")
    "Wing_Difference:SpeciesMOCH" else "Wing_Difference"
  v <- ct[term, ]
  crit <- if (count)
    qnorm(0.975) else qt(0.975, df.residual(f))
  ef[[paste(y, sc)]] <- data.frame(response = y, scope = sc, n = nobs(f), estimate = v[1], SE = v[2],
    CI_low = v[1] - crit * v[2], CI_high = v[1] + crit * v[2], p = v[4])
  fs[[paste(y, sc)]] <- f
}
ef <- bind_rows(ef) %>%
  group_by(scope) %>%
  mutate(BH_p = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()
write.csv(ef, file.path(b, "independent_record_exclusion_reproductive_models.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(parms, file.path(b, "independent_record_exclusion_SMI_parameters.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(fs, file.path(b, "independent_record_exclusion_models.rds"))

ef %>%
  filter(scope == "combined")
```


## Reviewers 1 and 2: would a quadratic relationship fit better?

Add a quadratic wing-difference term and its interaction with species, while
keeping elevation, categorical year, and the count dispersion structure. These
comparisons use the same complete cases as the linear models. 

```{r quadratic_models}
quadratic_models <- list()
quadratic_rows <- list()
for (y in responses) {
  ss <- BS[complete.cases(BS[c(y, "Wing_Difference", "Elevation_km", "Year", "Species")]), ]
  linear <- fits[[paste(y, "all_attempts", "combined", sep = "|")]]
  formula <- as.formula(paste(y, "~ poly(Wing_Difference, 2) * Species + Elevation_km + factor(Year)"))
  count <- y %in% count_responses
  quadratic <- if (count)
    glmmTMB(formula, ss, family = compois(link = "log"), dispformula = if (y == "Egg_Number")
      ~Species else ~1) else lm(formula, ss)
  if (count)
    stopifnot(quadratic$fit$convergence == 0, quadratic$sdr$pdHess)
  ll0 <- logLik(linear)
  ll1 <- logLik(quadratic)
  df <- attr(ll1, "df") - attr(ll0, "df")
  LR <- 2 * as.numeric(ll1 - ll0)
  quadratic_models[[y]] <- quadratic
  quadratic_rows[[y]] <- data.frame(response = y, n = nrow(ss), AIC_linear = AIC(linear), AIC_quadratic = AIC(quadratic),
    delta_AIC = AIC(quadratic) - AIC(linear), LR, df, p = pchisq(LR, df = df, lower.tail = FALSE))
}
quadratic_results <- bind_rows(quadratic_rows)
write.csv(quadratic_results, file.path(output_dir, "linear_quadratic_comparisons.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(quadratic_models, file.path(output_dir, "quadratic_models.rds"))
quadratic_results
```

## Reviewers 1 and 2: average nestling mass and brood size

Add brood size to the nestling-mass model, using the same complete cases for
all three models within a species. The fixed year results match the main
analysis. The random year versions are the additional comparisons described
in the supplement.

```{r brood_size_sensitivity}
brood_models <- list()
brood_fixed_rows <- list()
brood_random_rows <- list()
for (sp in c("BCCH", "MOCH")) {
  ss <- BS[BS$Species == sp & complete.cases(BS[c("Avg_Nestling_Weight", "Nestling_Number", "Wing_Difference",
    "Elevation", "Year")]), ]
  fixed_formulas <- list(base = Avg_Nestling_Weight ~ Wing_Difference + Elevation + factor(Year), brood = Avg_Nestling_Weight ~
    Wing_Difference + Nestling_Number + Elevation + factor(Year), interaction = Avg_Nestling_Weight ~
    Wing_Difference * Nestling_Number + Elevation + factor(Year))
  random_formulas <- list(base = Avg_Nestling_Weight ~ Wing_Difference + Elevation + (1 | Year), brood = Avg_Nestling_Weight ~
    Wing_Difference + Nestling_Number + Elevation + (1 | Year), interaction = Avg_Nestling_Weight ~
    Wing_Difference * Nestling_Number + Elevation + (1 | Year))
  for (model in c("base", "brood", "interaction")) {
    fit <- lm(fixed_formulas[[model]], ss)
    cc <- coefficient_table(fit)
    brood_fixed_rows[[paste(sp, model)]] <- data.frame(Species = sp, model, n = nobs(fit), AIC = AIC(fit),
      cc[cc$term == "Wing_Difference", ], row.names = NULL)
    brood_models[[paste(sp, "fixed", model)]] <- fit
    fit <- lme4::lmer(random_formulas[[model]], ss, REML = FALSE)
    cc <- coef(summary(fit))["Wing_Difference", ]
    brood_random_rows[[paste(sp, model)]] <- data.frame(Species = sp, model, n = nobs(fit), AIC = AIC(fit),
      estimate = cc[1], SE = cc[2], CI_low = cc[1] - qnorm(0.975) * cc[2], CI_high = cc[1] + qnorm(0.975) *
        cc[2], year_variance = as.data.frame(VarCorr(fit))$vcov[1], singular = isSingular(fit))
    brood_models[[paste(sp, "random", model)]] <- fit
  }
}
brood_fixed <- bind_rows(brood_fixed_rows)
```

## Reviewer 1: compare observed and random pairings

Use attempt-specific wing lengths for 10,000 randomizations within species.
The female-larger comparison uses all attempts. The two male-larger categories
use the observed male-larger subset, with simulated proportions calculated among
simulated male-larger pairs. The two tests use complementary draws. 

```{r random_pairing}
permutation <- list()
permutation_draws <- list()
B <- 10000L
d <- BS
out <- output_dir
for (sp in c("MOCH", "BCCH")) {
  ss <- d[d$Species == sp & complete.cases(d[c("Male.Wing.Chord", "Female.Wing.Chord")]), ]
  delta <- ss$Male.Wing.Chord - ss$Female.Wing.Chord
  threshold <- median(delta[delta > 0])
  set.seed(if (sp == "MOCH")
    26 else 27)
  for (cat in c("Female-larger", "Male-slightly-larger", "Male-much-larger")) {
    s <- if (cat == "Female-larger")
      ss else ss[delta > 0, ]
    wd <- s$Male.Wing.Chord - s$Female.Wing.Chord
    slight <- function(x) if (sp == "MOCH")
      x > 0 & x <= threshold else x > 0 & x < threshold
    much <- function(x) if (sp == "MOCH")
      x > threshold else x >= threshold
    observed <- if (cat == "Female-larger")
      sum(wd < 0) else if (cat == "Male-slightly-larger")
      sum(slight(wd)) else sum(much(wd))
    obs_prop <- observed/nrow(s)
    null <- if (cat == "Male-much-larger")
      1 - null_slight else replicate(B, {
      z <- sample(s$Male.Wing.Chord) - sample(s$Female.Wing.Chord)
      if (cat == "Female-larger")
        mean(z < 0) else if (cat == "Male-slightly-larger")
        sum(slight(z))/sum(z > 0) else sum(much(z))/sum(z > 0)
    })
    if (cat == "Male-slightly-larger")
      null_slight <- null
    permutation_draws[[paste(sp, cat)]] <- data.frame(Species = sp, category = cat, iteration = seq_len(B),
      proportion = null)
    lower <- (1 + sum(null <= obs_prop + 1e-12))/(B + 1)
    upper <- (1 + sum(null >= obs_prop - 1e-12))/(B + 1)
    permutation[[paste(sp, cat)]] <- data.frame(Species = sp, category = cat, threshold, observed_n = observed,
      denominator = nrow(s), observed_prop = obs_prop, null_mean = mean(null), null_low = unname(quantile(null,
        0.025)), null_high = unname(quantile(null, 0.975)), p_lower = lower, p_upper = upper,
      p_directional = if (cat == "Male-slightly-larger")
        upper else lower, iterations = B)
  }
}
write.csv(bind_rows(permutation), file.path(out, "randomization_recomputed.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(permutation_draws), file.path(out, "randomization_draws.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

randomization_results <- bind_rows(permutation)
randomization_results$MC_SE <- with(randomization_results, sqrt(p_directional * (1 - p_directional)/(iterations +
  1)))
null_draws <- bind_rows(permutation_draws)
write.csv(randomization_results, file.path(output_dir, "randomization_recomputed.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
randomization_results
```


## SMI and the shared wing-length component

The original SMI models share wing length with the predictor. Following
Garcia-Berthou (2001) and Freckleton (2002), fit log mass while accounting for the parent's own log wing length. Repeat the continuous and categorical comparisons with no shared parents and with HC3 standard errors. Adjust the two parental-sex tests within each analysis, subset, model scope, and uncertainty estimate.

```{r SMI_shared_wing}
SMI_models <- list()
SMI_rows <- list()
SMI_membership <- list()
for (sex in c("Female", "Male")) {
  ss <- BS
  ss$Mass <- ss[[paste0(sex, ".Weight")]]
  ss$OwnWing <- ss[[paste0(sex, ".Wing.Chord")]]
  ss <- ss[complete.cases(ss[c("Mass", "OwnWing", "Wing_Difference", "Elevation_km", "Year")]), ]
  ss <- ss[ss$Mass > 0 & ss$OwnWing > 0, ]
  ss$logMass <- log(ss$Mass)
  ss$logWing <- log(ss$OwnWing)
  ss$category <- factor(ss$Wing_Difference_Category, levels = c("Much", "Slightly"))
  for (analysis in c("continuous", "categorical")) {
    eligible <- if (analysis == "continuous")
      ss else ss[ss$Wing_Difference > 0, ]
    for (subset in c("all_attempts", "no_shared_parent")) {
      selected <- if (subset == "all_attempts")
        eligible else select_attempts(eligible, subset)
      SMI_membership[[paste(sex, analysis, subset)]] <- data.frame(sex, analysis, subset, selected[c(".row",
        "Year", "Species", "Male.ID", "Female.ID", "Pair.ID")])
      for (scope in c("BCCH", "MOCH", "combined")) {
        dd <- if (scope == "combined")
          selected else selected[selected$Species == scope, ]
        predictor <- if (analysis == "continuous")
          "Wing_Difference" else "category"
        term <- if (analysis == "continuous")
          "Wing_Difference" else "categorySlightly"
        if (scope == "combined")
          term <- paste0(term, ":SpeciesMOCH")
        rhs <- if (scope == "combined")
          paste0(predictor, "*Species + logWing*Species") else paste0(predictor, " + logWing")
        formula <- as.formula(paste("logMass ~", rhs, "+ Elevation_km + factor(Year)"))
        fit <- lm(formula, dd)
        key <- paste(sex, analysis, subset, scope, sep = "|")
        SMI_models[[key]] <- fit
        for (uncertainty in c("model", "HC3")) {
          vv <- if (uncertainty == "HC3")
          vcovHC(fit, type = "HC3") else vcov(fit)
          estimate <- unname(coef(fit)[term])
          se <- sqrt(vv[term, term])
          df <- df.residual(fit)
          SMI_rows[[paste(key, uncertainty)]] <- data.frame(sex, analysis, scheme = subset, scope,
          covariance = uncertainty, n = nobs(fit), estimate, SE = se, df, CI_low = estimate -
            qt(0.975, df) * se, CI_high = estimate + qt(0.975, df) * se, p = 2 * pt(-abs(estimate/se),
            df))
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
SMI_results <- bind_rows(SMI_rows) %>%
  group_by(analysis, scheme, scope, covariance) %>%
  mutate(BH_p_two_sexes = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()
write.csv(SMI_results, file.path(output_dir, "SMI_coupling_effects.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(SMI_membership), file.path(output_dir, "SMI_retained_attempts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(SMI_models, file.path(output_dir, "SMI_coupling_models.rds"))
SMI_results %>%
  filter(scheme == "all_attempts", covariance == "model")
```


## Reviewer 1: check collinearity

Calculate column VIFs from the complete design matrix, including year indicators
and interactions. Centering is a diagnostic check only; the model estimates use
the original predictor. Also calculate term-level GVIFs from the coefficient
correlation matrix, accounting for the multiple coefficients representing year.

```{r collinearity}
d <- BS
b <- output_dir
ys <- responses
vifs <- list()
gvifs <- list()
for (y in ys) for (sc in c("combined", "BCCH", "MOCH")) {
  f <- fits[[paste(y, "all_attempts", sc, sep = "|")]]
  dd <- d[complete.cases(d[c(y, "Wing_Difference", "Species", "Elevation_km", "Year")]), ]
  if (sc != "combined")
    dd <- dd[dd$Species == sc, ]
  dd$Species <- factor(dd$Species, levels = c("BCCH", "MOCH"))
  for (centered in c(FALSE, TRUE)) {
    zz <- dd
    if (centered)
      zz$Wing_Difference <- zz$Wing_Difference - mean(zz$Wing_Difference)
    fm <- if (sc == "combined")
      ~Wing_Difference * Species + Elevation_km + factor(Year) else ~Wing_Difference + Elevation_km + factor(Year)
    mm <- model.matrix(fm, zz)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
    for (j in seq_len(ncol(mm))) {
      aux <- lm(mm[, j] ~ mm[, -j, drop = FALSE])
      vv <- 1/(1 - summary(aux)$r.squared)
      vifs[[length(vifs) + 1L]] <- data.frame(response = y, scope = sc, centered, term = colnames(mm)[j],
        VIF = vv)
    }

    if (!centered) {
      vv <- if (inherits(f, "glmmTMB"))
        as.matrix(vcov(f)$cond) else vcov(f)
      rr <- cov2cor(vv[-1, -1, drop = FALSE])
      aa <- attr(model.matrix(fm, zz), "assign")[-1]
      tt <- attr(terms(fm), "term.labels")
      ldet <- function(x) if (nrow(x) == 0)
        0 else as.numeric(determinant(x, logarithm = TRUE)$modulus)
      for (k in unique(aa)) {
        ix <- which(aa == k)
        g <- exp(ldet(rr[ix, ix, drop = FALSE]) + ldet(rr[-ix, -ix, drop = FALSE]) - ldet(rr))
        gvifs[[length(gvifs) + 1]] <- data.frame(response = y, scope = sc, term = tt[k], df = length(ix),
          GVIF = g, GVIF_adjusted = g^(1/(2 * length(ix))))
      }
    }
  }
}
write.csv(bind_rows(vifs), file.path(b, "full_design_VIF.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(gvifs), file.path(b, "term_GVIF.csv"), row.names = FALSE)



vif_results <- bind_rows(vifs)
gvif_results <- bind_rows(gvifs)
vif_results %>%
  group_by(scope, centered) %>%
  summarise(max_VIF = max(VIF), .groups = "drop")
gvif_results %>%
  group_by(scope) %>%
  summarise(min_adjusted_GVIF = min(GVIF_adjusted), max_adjusted_GVIF = max(GVIF_adjusted), .groups = "drop")
```


## Model diagnostics

Check residual and normal quantile plots for the Gaussian models. For count and
mixed models, use 2,000 DHARMa simulations. Save the diagnostic results and plots along with convergence and variance information. A warning from a quantile
smoother is recorded separately from model convergence.

```{r diagnostics}
pdf(file.path(diagnostic_dir, "Gaussian_residual_plots.pdf"), width = 8, height = 7)
for (y in responses[!responses %in% count_responses]) {
  for (scope in c("combined", "BCCH", "MOCH")) {
    fit <- fits[[paste(y, "all_attempts", scope, sep = "|")]]
    par(mfrow = c(2, 2), oma = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
    plot(fit, which = c(1, 2, 3, 5), sub.caption = "")
    mtext(paste(response_labels[match(y, responses)], scope), outer = TRUE)
  }
}
dev.off()

pdf(file.path(diagnostic_dir, "SMI_mass_at_size_residuals.pdf"), width = 8, height = 7)
for (sex in c("Female", "Male")) {
  for (scope in c("BCCH", "MOCH", "combined")) {
    fit <- SMI_models[[paste(sex, "continuous", "all_attempts", scope, sep = "|")]]
    par(mfrow = c(2, 2), oma = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
    plot(fit, which = c(1, 2, 3, 5), sub.caption = "")
    mtext(paste(sex, scope, "log mass with own wing length"), outer = TRUE)
  }
}
dev.off()

count_diagnostics <- list()
dispersion_rows <- list()
dispersion_coefficients <- list()
pdf(file.path(diagnostic_dir, "Count_model_DHARMa.pdf"), width = 8, height = 7)
for (y in count_responses) {
  for (subset in c("all_attempts", subsets)) {
    fit <- fits[[paste(y, subset, "combined", sep = "|")]]
    sim <- simulateResiduals(fit, n = 2000, plot = FALSE, seed = 123)
    warning_text <- character()
    withCallingHandlers(plot(sim), warning = function(w) {
      warning_text <<- c(warning_text, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    })
    quantile_p <- withCallingHandlers(tryCatch(testQuantiles(sim, plot = FALSE)$p.value, error = function(e) {
      warning_text <<- conditionMessage(e)
      NA_real_
    }), warning = function(w) {
      warning_text <<- c(warning_text, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    })
    count_diagnostics[[paste(y, subset)]] <- data.frame(response = y, scheme = subset, n = nobs(fit),
      convergence = fit$fit$convergence, positive_definite_Hessian = fit$sdr$pdHess, uniformity_p = testUniformity(sim,
        plot = FALSE)$p.value, dispersion_p = testDispersion(sim, plot = FALSE)$p.value, outlier_p = testOutliers(sim,
        plot = FALSE, type = "bootstrap")$p.value, quantile_p = if (length(warning_text))
        NA_real_ else quantile_p, quantile_warning = paste(unique(warning_text), collapse = "; "))
    if (length(warning_text)) {
      warning(paste(y, subset, "DHARMa diagnostic:", paste(unique(warning_text), collapse = "; ")))
    }
  }
  for (scope in c("combined", "BCCH", "MOCH")) {
    fit <- fits[[paste(y, "all_attempts", scope, sep = "|")]]
    for (sp in if (scope == "combined")
      c("BCCH", "MOCH") else scope) {
      nd <- BS[BS$Species == sp & complete.cases(BS[c(y, "Wing_Difference", "Elevation_km", "Year")]),
        ][1, ]
      dispersion_rows[[paste(y, scope, sp)]] <- data.frame(response = y, scope, Species = sp, phi = as.numeric(predict(fit,
        newdata = nd, type = "disp")))
    }
    cc <- coef(summary(fit))$disp
    if (!is.null(cc) && nrow(cc) > 0) {
      dispersion_coefficients[[paste(y, scope)]] <- data.frame(response = y, scope, term = rownames(cc),
        estimate = cc[, 1], SE = cc[, 2], statistic = cc[, 3], p = cc[, 4], row.names = NULL)
    }
  }
}
dev.off()
write.csv(bind_rows(count_diagnostics), file.path(output_dir, "count_model_diagnostics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(dispersion_rows), file.path(output_dir, "count_dispersion_by_species.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(dispersion_coefficients), file.path(output_dir, "count_dispersion_coefficients.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE)

mixed_diagnostics <- list()
pdf(file.path(diagnostic_dir, "Dimorphism_and_pairing_diagnostics.pdf"), width = 8, height = 7)
for (i in seq_along(mods)) {
  fit <- mods[[i]]
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
  plot(fitted(fit), resid(fit), xlab = "Fitted", ylab = "Residual", main = names(mods)[i])
  abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
  qqnorm(resid(fit))
  qqline(resid(fit))
  sim <- simulateResiduals(fit, n = 2000, plot = FALSE, seed = 2700 + i)
  mixed_diagnostics[[names(mods)[i]]] <- data.frame(model = names(mods)[i], uniformity_p = testUniformity(sim,
    plot = FALSE)$p.value, dispersion_p = testDispersion(sim, plot = FALSE)$p.value, outlier_p = testOutliers(sim,
    plot = FALSE, type = "bootstrap")$p.value)
}
dev.off()
write.csv(bind_rows(mixed_diagnostics), file.path(output_dir, "dimorphism_pairing_DHARMa.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
bind_rows(count_diagnostics) %>%
  filter(scheme == "all_attempts")
```

```{r study_map}
nestbox_coords <- read_excel(coordinate_file, sheet = "nest box list")
clean_location_code <- function(x) {
  x <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  x_upper <- str_to_upper(x)

  case_when(str_starts(x_upper, "BLD") | x_upper == "CU" ~ "BLD", str_detect(x_upper, "SUGARLOAF") |
    str_starts(x_upper, "SGR") | x_upper == "BLD/SGR" ~ "SGR", str_starts(x_upper, "NED") ~ "NED",
    str_starts(x_upper, "MRS") ~ "MRS", str_starts(x_upper, "FLG") ~ "FLG", TRUE ~ x_upper)
}

get_box_number <- function(x) {
  as.integer(str_extract(as.character(x), "\\d+"))
}

    box_number = get_box_number(Nestbox))

lonlat_to_tile <- function(lon, lat, zoom) {
  lat_rad <- lat * pi/180
  n <- 2^zoom

  data.frame(x = floor((lon + 180)/360 * n), y = floor((1 - log(tan(lat_rad) + 1/cos(lat_rad))/pi)/2 *
    n))
}

tile_to_lonlat_bounds <- function(x, y, zoom) {
  n <- 2^zoom

  c(xmin = x/n * 360 - 180, xmax = (x + 1)/n * 360 - 180, ymin = atan(sinh(pi * (1 - 2 * (y + 1)/n))) *
    180/pi, ymax = atan(sinh(pi * (1 - 2 * y/n))) * 180/pi)
}

    cols <- colorRampPalette(c("#FF7AC1", "#EC2E90", "#B0005B"))(length(years))

  names(cols) <- years
  cols
}
```

## Make the manuscript and supplemental figures

Predictions hold year at 2024 and elevation at the response's complete-case
median. Keep the prediction settings with the plots. The combined curves use
the pooled observed range, as in the manuscript; mountain chickadee curves
above 8 mm are extrapolations. Panels E and F show the original SMI models,
not the conditional log-mass checks.

```{r figures}
style_dir <- figure_dir
ys <- responses
original_labels <- c("First-egg date (day of year)", "Clutch size", "Brood size at day 12", "Average nestling mass (g)",
  "Female SMI (g)", "Male SMI (g)", "Provisioning rate (visits/h)")
species_colors <- c(BCCH = "#0072B2", MOCH = "#CC79A7")
save_original <- function(plot, name, width, height) {
  ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), plot = plot, width = width, height = height,
    dpi = 600, bg = "white")
  ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot = plot, width = width, height = height,
    bg = "white")
}
predict_current <- function(f, grid) {
  count <- inherits(f, "glmmTMB")
  pr <- if (count)
    predict(f, newdata = grid, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE) else predict(f, newdata = grid, se.fit = TRUE)
  cr <- if (count)
    qnorm(0.975) else qt(0.975, df.residual(f))
  grid$predicted <- as.numeric(pr$fit)
  grid$conf.low <- grid$predicted - cr * as.numeric(pr$se.fit)
  grid$conf.high <- grid$predicted + cr * as.numeric(pr$se.fit)
  if (count)
    grid[c("predicted", "conf.low", "conf.high")] <- lapply(grid[c("predicted", "conf.low", "conf.high")],
      exp)
  grid
}
settings <- bind_rows(lapply(ys, function(response) {
  dd <- BS[complete.cases(BS[c(response, "Species", "Wing_Difference", "Elevation_km", "Year")]), ]
  bind_rows(lapply(c("combined", "BCCH", "MOCH"), function(scope) data.frame(response, scope, Year = 2024,
    Elevation_m = median(dd$Elevation), n = nobs(fits[[paste(response, "all_attempts", scope, sep = "|")]]))))
}))
write.csv(settings, file.path(output_dir, "figure_prediction_settings.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
make_style_predictions <- function(response, scope) {
  dd <- BS[complete.cases(BS[c(response, "Species", "Wing_Difference", "Elevation_km", "Year")]), ]
  st <- settings[settings$response == response & settings$scope == scope, ]
  if (scope != "combined")
    dd <- dd[dd$Species == scope, ]
  # Preserve the original plotting algorithm's common range for the main figure.
  grid <- expand.grid(Wing_Difference = sort(unique(c(seq(min(dd$Wing_Difference), max(dd$Wing_Difference),
    length.out = 100), dd$Wing_Difference))), Species = if (scope == "combined")
    c("BCCH", "MOCH") else scope, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  grid$Species <- factor(grid$Species, levels = c("BCCH", "MOCH"))
  grid$Elevation_km <- (st$Elevation_m - 2000)/1000
  grid$Year <- st$Year
  pp <- predict_current(fits[[paste(response, "all_attempts", scope, sep = "|")]], grid)
  pp$response <- response
  pp$scope <- scope
  list(data = dd, predictions = pp)
}
# Figure 1: map, sex differences, and mate wing lengths.
sex_fill_cols <- c(F = "#E1BE6A", M = "#40B0A6")
boxes <- list()
scatters <- list()
for (sp in c("MOCH", "BCCH")) {
  dd <- BSpop[BSpop$Species == sp, ]
  dd$Sex <- factor(dd$Sex, levels = c("F", "M"))
  dd$Nest.ID <- paste(dd$Nestbox, dd$Year)
  dots <- dd %>%
    count(Sex, Wing.Chord, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(n2 = n/2)
  links <- dd %>%
    group_by(Nest.ID) %>%
    filter(n_distinct(Sex) == 2) %>%
    ungroup()
  lo <- if (sp == "MOCH")
    60 else 58
  boxes[[sp]] <- ggplot(dd, aes(Sex, Wing.Chord)) + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Sex), alpha = 1, outlier.alpha = 0,
    width = 0.5, linewidth = 0.35) + geom_line(data = links, aes(group = Nest.ID), alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_point(data = dots, aes(size = n2), alpha = 1, color = "grey20") + scale_fill_manual(values = sex_fill_cols) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 3.5) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(lo, 76), breaks = seq(lo, 76,
    2), expand = expansion(mult = 0)) + theme_cowplot() + theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9), plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 6, 6)) + labs(x = "Sex", y = if (sp ==
    "MOCH")
    "Wing length (mm)" else "")
  dd <- BS[BS$Species == sp, ]
  x <- dd$Female.Wing.Chord
  y <- dd$Male.Wing.Chord
  slope <- sign(cor(x, y)) * sd(y)/sd(x)
  intercept <- mean(y) - slope * mean(x)
  line <- data.frame(x = seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = 100))
  line$y <- intercept + slope * line$x
  scatters[[sp]] <- ggplot(dd, aes(Female.Wing.Chord, Male.Wing.Chord)) + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
    color = "#E8E8E8", linewidth = 0.5) + geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 1, color = "#555555") +

    x = lo + 0.8, y = 74.7, label = sprintf("SMA: y = %.2f + %.2fx; R2 = %.2f", intercept, slope,

    y = if (sp == "MOCH")
      "Male wing length (mm)" else "")
}

# Figure 2: observed wing differences and random pairings.
null <- null_draws
tests <- randomization_results
dens <- list()
histograms <- list()
for (sp in c("MOCH", "BCCH")) {
  dd <- BS[BS$Species == sp, ]
  cut <- if (sp == "MOCH")
    3 else 4
  ymax <- max(density(dd$Wing_Difference)$y) * 1.05
  dens[[sp]] <- ggplot(dd, aes(Wing_Difference)) + geom_density(fill = species_colors[sp], alpha = 0.5,
    linewidth = 0.3) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) + geom_vline(xintercept = cut,
    linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) + annotate("text", x = -2.4, y = ymax * 0.5, label = "Female larger",
    size = 3.4) + annotate("text", x = cut/2, y = ymax * 0.5, label = "Male slightly\nlarger", size = 3.4) +
    annotate("text", x = cut + 2.1, y = ymax * 0.5, label = "Male much\nlarger", size = 3.4) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-7,
    12.2), breaks = seq(-6, 12, 2), expand = expansion(mult = 0)) + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-7,
    12.2), ylim = c(0, ymax), expand = FALSE) + theme_classic(base_size = 10) + theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black",
    fill = NA, linewidth = 0.35), axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"), plot.margin = margin(2,
    5, 2, 2)) + labs(x = if (sp == "BCCH")
    "Difference Between Male and Female Wing Chord (mm)" else NULL, y = "Density")
  for (cat in c("Female-larger", "Male-slightly-larger", "Male-much-larger")) {
    nn <- null[null$Species == sp & null$category == cat, ]
    tt <- tests[tests$Species == sp & tests$category == cat, ]
    xx <- 100 * nn$proportion
    obs <- 100 * tt$observed_prop
    label <- switch(cat, `Female-larger` = "Percent female larger\npairings", `Male-slightly-larger` = "Percent male slightly\nlarger pairings",
      `Male-much-larger` = "Percent male much\nlarger pairings")
    pp <- ggplot(nn, aes(proportion * 100)) + geom_histogram(bins = 10, fill = species_colors[sp],
      color = "black", alpha = if (sp == "BCCH")
        0.8 else 1, linewidth = 0.3) + geom_vline(xintercept = obs, color = "black", linewidth = 1.8) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = obs, color = "#ADD8E6", linewidth = 1) + theme_cowplot() + labs(x = if (sp ==
      "BCCH")
      label else NULL, y = "Count") + theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 10), axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.margin = margin(3, 7, 3, 3))
    sig <- if (tt$p_directional < 0.001)
      "***" else if (tt$p_directional < 0.01)
      "**" else if (tt$p_directional < 0.05)
      "*" else ""
    if (nchar(sig))
      pp <- pp + annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = sig, hjust = 1.8, vjust = 1.1, size = 8)
    histograms[[paste(sp, cat)]] <- pp
  }
}

      theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4))
  }
  row1 <- plot_grid(plotlist = ps[1:3], ncol = 3)
  row2 <- plot_grid(ps[[4]], ps[[6]], ncol = 2)
  row3 <- plot_grid(ps[[5]], ps[[7]], ncol = 2)
  save_original(plot_grid(row1, row2, row3, ncol = 1), if (sp == "MOCH")
    "Figure_S2" else "Figure_S3", if (sp == "MOCH")
    8.92 else 6.93, 5.03)
}
write.csv(bind_rows(plot_prediction_records), file.path(output_dir, "plotting_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```


## Predicted brood size and nestling mass

Report the mountain predictions at −2 and 8 mm on the response scale, with the
same elevation and year settings used in Figure 3.

```{r predictions_and_versions}
endpoint_rows <- list()
for (y in c("Nestling_Number", "Avg_Nestling_Weight")) {
  st <- settings[settings$response == y & settings$scope == "combined", ]
  grid <- data.frame(Wing_Difference = c(-2, 8), Species = factor("MOCH", levels = c("BCCH", "MOCH")),
    Elevation_km = (st$Elevation_m - 2000)/1000, Year = 2024)
  pp <- predict_current(fits[[paste(y, "all_attempts", "combined", sep = "|")]], grid)
  endpoint_rows[[y]] <- data.frame(response = y, pp)
}
endpoints <- bind_rows(endpoint_rows)
write.csv(endpoints, file.path(output_dir, "mountain_prediction_endpoints.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
endpoints

# Record the software versions used for this run.
capture.output(sessionInfo(), file = file.path(output_dir, "session_info.txt"))
```
